newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste sees improvement despite uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Neste sees improvement despite uncertainty.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said on Friday it expected its performance in 1997 to improve despite uncertainty over price development in its markets.
"Uncertain market prices notwithstanding, Neste's performance in 1997 is likely to be better than in 1996," the company said in a statement with its 1996 results.

"The movement of one dollar in the crude oil price accounts for a change of some 60 million markka in the performance of the upstream business, while a similar movement in the refining margins has an impact of some 350 million markka in the results of the oil division," Neste said.
The international refining margin had hovered around $1 in the early months of this year while crude oil prices have been falling, Neste said.
As the company closed its accounts, Neste said, it was still in talks on the sale of its 50 percent stake in petrochemicals venture Borealis, jointly owned with Statoil.
